constraints: Preserve original Error cause and diagnostic fields. No automatic retry, focus manipulation, or capture-scope expansion.

current_en: Stop and save the recording before {action}?
en: Stop recording and attempt to save it before {action}?
context: Recording guard for another Desktop action. Current confirmStop awaits stop but returns true even if stop returns an error result; wording cannot guarantee a successful save.
constraints: Keep numeric response 1 as stop-and-continue; response 0/defaultId=0/cancelId=0 keeps recording and cancels the pending action. Keep capture-start/capture-stop/capture-status IDs and state unchanged. No new retry or save-success gate in this copy-only stage. Policy checkpoint before integration: decide whether save failure should block close/quit; use separate whole-message keys for close and quit if grammar requires it.

current_en: Keep this window open or minimize it to continue. Canceling stops the owned installation processes; prepared files are retained so you can retry on the next launch.
en: Keep this window open or minimize it to continue. Canceling stops this setup’s installation processes and keeps prepared files. Relaunch StandTerm to try again.
context: Close confirmation during preparation. Cancellation targets owned setup processes and waits for cleanup; prepared files remain.
constraints: Keep button index 0 Keep preparing and 1 Cancel setup; defaultId=0/cancelId=0. Preserve stale-window check and cooperative cancellation. Do not imply all Python processes are stopped or retry is automatic.

current_en: and downloads and installs Python dependencies from your configured package index. Dependencies can execute installation code. Internet access and disk space are required.
en: Python dependencies are downloaded from your configured package index and installed in the private environment. Installation can run code and requires internet access and disk space.
context: Exact dependency-effects fragment in preparePackagedBackend confirmation detail; preceding Core-copy/path/Python requirements and following retention policy remain separate.
constraints: Keep existing environment/backend selection and raw destination path. Confirm response 1 creates the environment; 0/defaultId/cancelId cancel. Do not imply bundled or verified dependencies, system Python installation, or privilege elevation.

current_en: Failed setup is retained for retry. Uninstall keeps environments by default; optional cleanup moves only verified idle venvs to a recovery folder. Core and user data are retained.
en: Failed setup files are kept for retry. Uninstall keeps environments by default. Optional cleanup moves verified idle venvs to recovery and keeps Core files and user data.
context: Exact retention fragment of the initial setup confirmation. The cleanup operation is a recoverable move rather than disk-space reclamation.
constraints: Keep venv-only cleanup boundary and verified/idle checks. Do not imply uninstall deletes Core or user data, that partial setup is ready, or that retry occurs without a user action.

current_en: {paths}\n\nNo disk space is freed. Core and settings are retained. Any environment that becomes busy or fails verification will be retained. Cancel keeps all listed venvs.
en: {paths}\n\nThis move does not free disk space. Core and settings stay in place. Busy or unverified environments are kept. Cancel keeps every listed venv.
context: Cleanup confirmation detail after candidate inventory, before detach-idle-venvs. Candidate paths are shown as a raw list.
constraints: Keep candidate IDs and source paths literal. Button index 0 keeps environments; index 1 moves listed candidates. defaultId=0/cancelId=0. Recheck eligibility; no deletion or permission expansion.

current_en: Cleanup did not report completion. Check venv-recovery before retrying.

constraints: Keep recovery-directory name venv-recovery literal. Do not claim no files moved, roll back, delete, or automatically retry.

constraints: Keep askac/standterm and main literal. Preserve refusal on local changes and no reset/stash behavior. No automatic update, retry, or implied equivalence to the verified installed bundle.
